title: Support Operations Report: Cost, Speed, Reopening, Satisfaction and Agent Concentration
executive_summary: Across 347 cleaned support tickets, mean resolution time was 75.19 minutes and total labor cost reached $27,422.90. Team Beta carries the highest labor cost at $10,247.36, while chat is the slowest channel at 83.04 mean minutes. Email tickets reopen at 17.24% versus 7.84% for chat, a 119.83% relative increase. A small segment of 12 high-cost, low-satisfaction tickets reopens at 8.33%. Median resolution is 65 minutes, satisfaction averages 4.15 (19 scores missing), and workload is spread across 18 agents, with the top agent handling 26 tickets (7.49% share).

key_findings.statement: The cleaned dataset contains 347 tickets, with a mean resolution time of 75.19 minutes and a total labor cost of $27,422.90.
Total labor cost by team: Beta $10,247.36, Gamma $9,387.73, Alpha $7,787.81. Beta accounts for the most labor spend, Alpha the least.
Mean resolution time by channel: chat 83.04 minutes, email 73.02 minutes, phone 69.25 minutes. Chat is the slowest channel and phone the fastest.
Email tickets reopen at 17.24% versus 7.84% for chat, a relative increase of 119.83% for email compared with chat.
12 tickets combine labor cost of at least $100 with a satisfaction score of 2 or lower; this high-cost, low-satisfaction segment reopens at 8.33%.
Resolution time has a median of 65 minutes and a sample standard deviation of 51.93 minutes, indicating wide spread. Mean satisfaction is 4.15, with 19 tickets missing a satisfaction score.
18 unique agents handled the tickets; the busiest single agent handled 26 tickets, a 7.49% share of all tickets, indicating workload is broadly distributed rather than concentrated.

limitations: 19 tickets are missing satisfaction scores; the 4.15 mean excludes them and could be biased if missingness is not random.
The high-cost, low-satisfaction segment contains only 12 tickets, so its 8.33% reopen rate is based on a small sample and is unstable.
The reopen comparison covers email and chat only; no verified reopen rate was computed for phone.
Team labor costs are totals and have not been normalized per ticket, so differences may reflect ticket volume rather than efficiency.
The export is a single snapshot with no time dimension in the verified metrics, so trends and seasonality cannot be assessed.
conclusion: Support operations handled 347 tickets at $27,422.90 total labor cost, with Beta the costliest team and chat the slowest channel. The clearest action signal is email's 17.24% reopen rate, well above chat's 7.84%; reviewing email resolution quality should be prioritized. Satisfaction is healthy at 4.15 and agent workload shows no risky concentration, with the top agent at just 7.49% of tickets.
